Features include product browsing, cart management, secure checkout, and payment processing. The platform helped establish the brand's online presence, increase visibility, and generate sales through a seamless shopping experience.

projects.name: Pie Budgeting
projects.description: Built a full-stack, AI-enabled personal budgeting application using React and Node.js that enables users to track income, expenses, and spending habits. Designed with simplicity and usability in mind, providing real-time insights to help users better manage their finances.

projects.name: AI Concierge Bot
projects.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) powered AI assistant that enables front-office advisors to quickly access client fee structures, financial data, and business policies through natural language queries. The solution delivers accurate, context-aware responses from internal documentation, improving efficiency when supporting client needs and reducing time spent searching for critical information.

projects.name: Samson Strength

projects.name: Family Photo Album
